analysis:
This batch contains only added test files: AddonCommandTests.swift, AddonHoldLoopTests.swift, AddonHoldServeLoopTests.swift, AddonHoldStoreTests.swift, and AddonIPCServerTests.swift (patch excerpt only, the unit has no head text). It adds no production code, so no security regression is introduced here. The tests describe a new attack surface that is implemented in files outside this batch: an add-on hold feature, a local AF_UNIX socket (addon.sock) in a runtime directory, and an ownership.lock machine lock. It also adds a persisted hold record (addon-hold.json), a CLI `darkbloom addon` command, and a lifecycle mailbox control path.

The tests cover these security-relevant properties:
- The runtime directory is 0700 and symlinks are refused (AddonHoldStoreTests.swift:72-81).
- The hold record is 0600, and unsafe or symlinked records are treated as invalid (lines 56-70).
- The peer is authenticated by a code-signing requirement pinned to team SLDQ2GJ6TL and identifier io.darkbloom.sandbox (lines 118-125).
- A non-add-on process is rejected (lines 127-137).
- A development identity is accepted only under #if DEBUG and only in a well-formed shape (lines 139-151).
- A hold can be used only by its own signer (AddonHoldLoopTests.swift:136-160).
- A hold cannot be reopened by an update, a reconnect, or a stop (lines 208-243).
- An expired lease is released only when the machine lock is free (lines 245-268).
- Held providers refuse routed work with a 503 draining reason (AddonHoldServeLoopTests.swift:42-48).
- The App Attest worker is untouched by holds (AddonHoldLoopTests.swift:133).

The integration pass must examine the production implementation in ProviderLoop (the addon hold service, handleAddonIPC, and handleAddonControl). It must also examine AddonIPCServer and the AddonPeerPolicy audit-token check. Questions for that review:
- Whether the DARKBLOOM_ADDON socket override environment variable can redirect the socket or lock in release builds.
- Whether a hold can be used as a denial of service against serving, since it bounds the lease to 30-600 seconds but is kept while the machine lock is held.
- How the hold state transitions interact with TB-011 authorization and the T-053 draining and connection state.

The test environment-override test (AddonHoldStoreTests.swift:98-113) suggests the override is accepted in production paths. That is unverified without the source, so I record it as a question rather than a finding.
